caption: The drawing features two objects on a plain, beige background. On the left side, there is a cylindrical, brown earthenware jar with a flared rim and two small looped handles protruding from the sides near the rim. The jar's surface is glossy, with slight variations in color, ranging from light brown to darker brown, and it has some subtle speckled texture. To the right of the jar, there is a shallow, circular lid or dish, also brown and glossy, with a central raised ring that appears to match the rim of the jar. Both objects are oriented upright, and the lid is positioned lower and to the right of the jar, suggesting that they are related. The rest of the background is empty and unadorned, drawing attention to the objects.
title: Crockery Churn
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
